text:
alex_chang: FYI small-but-urgent — after the kernel/driver patch this morning our GPU metrics daemon started exposing per-container GPU UUID labels, causing prometheus to explode from ~300 targets to ~2.6k. alerts are noisy and grafana SLO panels are garbage :grimacing:

maria_k: ugh. saw the spike in the grafana cluster-health board. which metric is high-cardinality?

alex_chang: metric is `gpu_mem_usage_bytes` with label `gpu_uuid` + `container_id`. agent is emitting both.

samir_patel: can we relabel at scrape time? prometheus relabeling could drop container_id or replace gpu_uuid with a hashed value.

maria_k: yes we can, but we should also fix agent to not emit container_id for long term. quick patch: prometheus scrape relabel to drop `container_id` and keep `gpu_model` + node.

jen_ops: I recommend a two-step mitigation: 1) immediate relabel rule to stop cardinality spike and silence affected alerts; 2) roll a canary of agent with a config change to stop emitting container-scoped labels and emit `gpu_family` instead.

alex_chang: agreed. I'm going to add a temporary scrape relabel into `prometheus-k8s` config. snippet I tested locally:```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
    action: keep
    regex: gpu-agent
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name]
    target_label: node
  - source_labels: [gpu_uuid]
    replacement: "${1}"
    regex: "(.*)"
    target_label: gpu_uuid_raw
  - regex: (.*)
    source_labels: [gpu_uuid_raw]
    action: replace
    replacement: "${1}" # placeholder, see hash step
  - source_labels: [gpu_uuid_raw]
    action: replace
    target_label: gpu_uuid
    replacement: "REDACTED_$1"
    # simpler: drop container_id to reduce cardinality
  - source_labels: [container_id]
    action: drop
```

samir_patel: that looks ok for immediate drop but prefer using `replacement: "${1}"` with `target_label: gpu_uuid_hash` and `hashmod` or `hash` relabel for stable bucketing. we don't want to lose ability to attribute node-level issues.

jen_ops: also let's add a PrometheusRule to mute the noisy SLO alert group for 1h while we remediate. I can do a temporary silence: `/silence -m "gpu agent cardinality blast" --ends 1h` in alertmanager.

maria_k: steps to roll the agent change? canary strategy?

alex_chang: plan: patch daemonset `gpu-metrics-agent` with new image tag `v2.1.1-cardinality-fix` and an env var `EMIT_CONTAINER_LABEL=false`. Rollout to 5 nodes (nodeSelector label `infra-canary=true`) first. If stable for 30m then rollout to remaining nodes with `kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/gpu-metrics-agent` or `kubectl set image`.

samir_patel: command cheat-sheet:```bash
# canary label on 5 nodes
kubectl label node <node-name> infra-canary=true
# patch daemonset to include nodeSelector for canary
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset gpu-metrics-agent --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"nodeSelector": {"infra-canary": "true"}}}}}'
# once verified, revert nodeSelector and rollout to all
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset gpu-metrics-agent --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"nodeSelector": null}}}}'
```

jen_ops: also gather logs before and after to prove fix: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gpu-agent --tail=200` and `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gpu-agent -p --since=10m` for crashed pods. attach to the ticket.

alex_chang: adding checklist to ticket INFRA-4123: 1) add prometheus relabel (cluster) 2) create Alertmanager silence 3) patch canary DS 4) monitor cardinality + SLO dashboards 5) roll full DS 6) revert temporary relabel after fix validated

maria_k: watch out for prometheus target churn — adjust `honor_labels` and `metric_relabel_configs` instead of scrape relabel if we need per-metric rewrite.

samir_patel: for longer term: change agent to expose `gpu_family`, `driver_version`, and `node` only. If we need per-container GPU usage, emit it to a separate /metrics/cgroup endpoint that is scraped less frequently or forwarded to Loki as logs.

infra-bot: Incident created: INFRA-4123 — "GPU agent label storm after kernel update" assigned to alex_chang. Priority: P2.

jen_ops: I'll take alert silences and create the canary nodes. alex, ping me when you patch daemonset and I'll watch the rollout. :thumbsup:

alex_chang: patch applied to prometheus config and silence created. canary nodes labeled. rolling canary now — will update in ~15m.

maria_k: thanks. If we still see label explosion after canary, we'll revert the kernel driver on those nodes and open a driver vendor bug.

samir_patel: good call. Also add a grafana panel that shows unique label counts over time for `gpu_uuid` so we can quickly spot regressions.

alex_chang: canary looks clean so far, cardinality down to expected levels. moving to staged rollout. will keep the temporary relabel for 2 hours then remove.

jen_ops: nice work everyone. once fully rolled, add a postmortem note about adding a PR gating step for node driver upgrades that run a small metric smoke test.

alex_chang: agreed — will draft postmortem and a test harness for the next driver upgrade. thanks all. :raised_hands:
